description: What the suite about a Hub that dies must notice (P9 ac-12, docs/PLAN-MODE.md "Hostile scenarios"): a hold that is not kept by a restart, a continue, a new plan or a second chat; an approval or a choice that is lost or made up; a request that outlives its task.

mutations.name: H1
mutations.what: a run of a held task is not held

mutations.name: H2
mutations.what: a plan that was denied ends plan mode

patches.new: if (wanted === false && planOnly(task)) task.planMode = false; else if (wanted === null && task === null) throw fault('plan_mode_pending',

mutations.name: H5
mutations.what: a planMode that is no boolean is read as one

patches.new: if (typeof value !== 'boolean') return Boolean(value); if (value === undefined) throw fault('invalid_plan_mode',

mutations.name: H6
mutations.what: a new plan on an approved task keeps the old approval

patches.old: if (existing && wantedPlan === true && !planOnly(task)) { task.planMode = true; task.planApproval = null; }

mutations.name: H7
mutations.what: the mode chosen for the execution is not put back

mutations.name: H8
mutations.what: a continued run of a held task is no plan-mode run

mutations.name: H9
mutations.what: a message puts a running run into plan mode

mutations.name: H10
mutations.what: a held chat is carried to the Companion

mutations.name: H11
mutations.what: the Companion starts a plan-mode task as an ordinary one
mutations.equivalent: BrowserRunner.start (refusePlanMode) refuses the same request with the same code, plan_mode_unsupported: two layers, and either one alone gives the answer the suite asserts.

mutations.name: H12
mutations.what: a chat that waits for its worktree forgets plan mode

mutations.name: H13
mutations.what: a chat that never ran leaves plan mode by a follow-up

mutations.name: H14
mutations.what: a stop leaves the request of its task on the stack

mutations.name: H15
mutations.what: the choice of an approval is not recorded with the task

patches.old: task.planApproval = { status: 'approved', at, revision: approvedRevision, editedByUser, execution };
patches.new: task.planApproval = { status: 'approved', at, revision: approvedRevision, editedByUser, execution: null };
